en.tagline: A guesthouse in Midigama, on the south coast of Sri Lanka.
en.closing: Live dates and prices are on Booking.com. If you'd rather ask us something first, call.

copyBlocks.heading: In the garden
copyBlocks.body:
The house is in a shady garden on Indhana Road. There's a hammock under the trees, and the ping-pong table has a thatched roof over it.

Every room downstairs opens onto the garden through its own terrace, with chairs outside and a table to eat at.

copyBlocks.heading: Yelum
copyBlocks.body: Yelum owns the house. As he once wrote to a guest, “I strive every day to make my customers' holidays as wonderful as possible.”

copyBlocks.heading: Breakfast
copyBlocks.body: Breakfast is included, and you can have it any time from 8 to 10 in the morning.

copyBlocks.heading: Old rooms and new
copyBlocks.body:
The garden rooms are downstairs. “The standard rooms may not be the newest,” Yelum says, “but they are popular with many vacationers due to their charm.”

The King Rooms upstairs are new, and their balconies look out into the trees.

copyBlocks.heading: Up on the roof
copyBlocks.body: There's a roof terrace as well, with a wooden table and chairs and the trees behind it. In one corner a Buddha sits on a pedestal, with offerings of flowers and fruit.

copyBlocks.heading: Getting here
copyBlocks.body:
Midigama railway station is 50 m from the house, so you can come by train.

Further out, Booking.com lists Ahangama Beach at 1.4 km, Weligama Beach at 4.2 km and Koggala Airport at 9 km.

On Google you may also find the house under its old name, Yelum Guest House.

testimonials.quote: We had an amazing stay at Lotus House. The family are so kind and welcoming. The breakfasts every day after surfing are amazing. Great location, only a 2 minute walk from the beach and the local surf spots. A very calm and relaxing vibe - lots of fun on the ping pong table in the garden. Our favourite stay in Sri Lanka, we would highly recommend, and we can’t wait to come back next year!
testimonials.author: Henry, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote: Very sweet Accommodation! A nice garden with a ping pong table and a great rooftop terrace, partly with a roof to get some shade. Had lots of yoga sessions up there with a wonderful view over the jungle. Location is great, lots of Restaurants around and just a few minutes walking distance to 4 surfspots, suitable for everyone from beginner/intermediates to highly advanced surfers. Yelum and his Father are super friendly and will help you with whatever Question comes up. I will be back :)
testimonials.author: Svenja, Germany

testimonials.quote: Yelum and his family provide such a welcoming and comfortable stay. The garden is like an oasis away from hustle of main road. Rooms are clean and comfortable and sitting on the porch breakfast is served with a range of options made by Yelum mother, the coconut roti and dhal a highlight for me and granola yogurt and fresh fruit and banana pancakes for my family. Yelum organised an airport pickup at midnight for us and welcomed us at 3 am. Would definitely stay again
testimonials.author: Fiona, Australia

testimonials.quote: The room was spacious and functional. The AC is really helping when it’s hot outsider. The highlight was truly the host, Yelum. He is always there to help, recommend things to do, plan trips (we went to a snake farm, batik factory and safari with him, which were all great experiences). The breakfast prepared by him and his mom for the traditional Sri Lankan dishes were also very good. You can go there with your eyes closed.
testimonials.author: Benjamin, Switzerland

testimonials.quote:
I enjoyed my stay here, and extended one more night. 
The location is perfect to go and surf at lazy left and right . 
the host is very welcoming and kind . breakfast is very nice. 
the room is ok , it gets very dusty pretty easily I think . Bed was comfortable enough .
testimonials.author: Giada, Italy

testimonials.quote: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Lotus Surf House. The property was clean and tidy, and it’s located in a quiet area that’s ideal for accessing surf spots suited to all skill levels. The owner and his wife were very personable and extremely helpful with anything I needed during my stay. I would definitely stay there again.
testimonials.author: Dimitrios, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote: Yelum was an incredible host who helped us out with not only planning our days in Mitigama, but also with planning our entire Sri Lanka trip! He was very kind and generous with his time and cooked a delicious breakfast. The room we stayed in was recently renovated and was beautiful and spacious. Yelum had a scooter that we could hire for a very decent price to get around during our stay. It is walking distance to the beach and a few lovely cafes. Thank Yelum for the awesome stay!
testimonials.author: Talia, Australia

testimonials.quote: Beautiful garden, the owners are so friendly and accomodating and the location is really close to all the cafes and restaurants in Midigama and walking distance to the two best surf spots around. I felt right at home here as a solo fem traveller!
testimonials.author: Nicole, Australia

testimonials.quote: Very friendly and lovely owner - always helpful, easy going. Yelum can also help you with getting around Sri Lanka. Beautiful garden and 5 min walk to the beach. Close to the train tracks but the train doesn't run very often. We were here 5 years ago and decided to come back this year and will do it again:)
testimonials.author: Holtmann, Switzerland

testimonials.quote: Super close to the beaches and waves. Super cool and friendly staff/owners. Super comfy rooms with working AC and hot water.
testimonials.author: Colin, Canada

testimonials.quote: For the price, my room was amazing. It felt like I was in the jungle. Hot water, AC, free breakfast, I’d stay again.
testimonials.author: ジョナ, Japan

testimonials.quote: I had a room without ac and it was fine but for a long period stay won’t recommend (since the humidity is high and my staff couldn’t get dry)
testimonials.author: Katsiaryna, Poland
